name: Ollama Runner — direct local-LLM HTTP
description: Salvages chuck-ollama-runner.mjs (325 LOC) into a typed plugin. Tool 'ollama_ask' posts to localhost:11434/api/generate with model + system + max_tokens + temp + keep_alive. Used by background watchers (chuck-introspect, chuck-decision-engine, chuck-morning-digest) to bypass the gateway's blocking subprocess harness. The .mjs survives as TRANSITIONAL DUPLICATE because apex-runtime-chooser.mjs subprocess-spawns it.

baseUrl.label: Ollama base URL
baseUrl.help: Defaults to http://localhost:11434 (env OLLAMA_BASE_URL also honored). Change for remote / Docker setups.
